subject: Invoice originator decision, delivery channel, and VAT evidence stewardship
messages:
From: Sven Lutz <sven.lutz@aptera.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2026 08:05:00 +0100
Subject: Who sends invoices / delivery channel for EU VAT evidence

Hi Olga / Connor,

Quick question as we get set up: who will be the official invoice originator for Aptera (email PDF vs portal push)? Our AP team needs a definitive owner so VAT evidence is linked correctly for VAT reclaim and local reporting. We have two constraints:

- We need a human-readable PDF copy emailed to aptera-payments@aptera.com for reconciliation.
- For automation, we prefer a portal/EDI push (XML) into our AP system, but that needs to be matched to a VAT certificate and the invoice originator must be consistent in the feed.

Can you confirm Redwood's recommended default and whether you can attach VAT proof to the invoice feed (or deliver it separately)? I can share our VAT cert if that helps.

Thanks,
Sven
Sven Lutz
AP Manager, Aptera Inc.
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sven Lutz <sven.lutz@aptera.com>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Who sends invoices / delivery channel for EU VAT evidence

Sven — thanks for the clear asks. Looping in our billing lead (Marissa) and payments engineer (Marcus) so we can confirm the originator, format, and VAT evidence handling.

High level: Redwood can be the invoice originator on behalf of Aptera (we issue the invoices and include the required tax metadata), or we can let Aptera create the legal invoice and have Redwood push a statement copy. Each approach has tradeoffs for AP reconciliation and for the VAT audit trail.

Marissa / Marcus — can you outline the preferred playbook and whether we can attach VAT proof to the XML feed or include a secure link to the certificate in each invoice payload? If possible, please include samples.

Olga
Head of Customer Success (Billing) 
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sven Lutz <sven.lutz@aptera.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2026 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Who sends invoices / delivery channel for EU VAT evidence

Thanks — summary and recommended options below. Attaching short playbook (redwood_invoice_playbook_v1.pdf) and an example XML payload (sample_invoice_xml_v1.xml).

Option A (Redwood = legal invoice originator) — recommended for simpler reconciliation
- Redwood issues the VAT invoice with our originator identifier; we include VAT number, tax breakdown, and a link to VAT evidence in the XML payload.
- Delivery: push XML to partner portal endpoint + email PDF copy to aptera-payments@aptera.com.
- Pros: single source of truth; VAT evidence link included on every invoice; we can timestamp & sign the payload.
- Cons: Aptera's AP team will need to accept Redwood as the originator in their mappings.

Option B (Aptera = legal originator) — for customers who must retain invoice control
- Aptera creates the legal invoice; Redwood will provide a consolidated statement or line-level detail in XML.
- Delivery: Redwood can still push XML or email PDF, but VAT evidence must be attached by Aptera or provided as a separate signed file.

VAT evidence handling:
- We can embed a secure link to a VAT certificate (short-lived signed URL) in the invoice XML and in the PDF footer.
- If you prefer attaching the cert, we can support attaching a PDF with the invoice bundle.

Required AP items from Aptera to proceed:
- Confirm which option (A or B) you prefer.
- Endpoint details for portal ingestion (SFTP/HTTPS API) or confirm email-only.
- AP contact and PO/PO-exception rules.

Next step proposal: if Aptera is open to Option A, we will run a single test invoice (XML + PDF copy) and produce a signed link to the VAT cert. Marcus — I'll need the sample XML signed and an example of the VAT link in the payload.

—Marissa
Senior Billing Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Sven Lutz <sven.lutz@aptera.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2026 09:18:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Who sends invoices / delivery channel for EU VAT evidence

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear options. Aptera prefers Option A (Redwood issues the legal invoice) as it minimizes manual steps for our AP team.

We will:
- Share our VAT certificate (attached: vat_certificate_aptera.pdf).
- Give you SFTP credentials for automated XML ingestion but we also need a PDF emailed to aptera-payments@aptera.com for internal matching on day 0.

Please proceed with a single test invoice (test invoice referencing PO 89023). We will validate matching on our side and confirm go-live after successful ingestion.

Sven
From: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sven Lutz <sven.lutz@aptera.com>
Cc: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2026 11:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Who sends invoices / delivery channel for EU VAT evidence

Thanks Sven — good to confirm Option A. Next steps on our side:

1) Marcus will push a signed sample XML and a PDF copy for PO 89023 to your SFTP and email aptera-payments@aptera.com by end of day tomorrow.
2) We'll include a short-lived signed URL to the VAT certificate in the XML payload and the PDF footer.
3) Please confirm the SFTP host, path, and user we should deliver to, and the AP contact for testing.

Action items:
- Aptera: provide SFTP details + AP contact + confirm any PO matching logic beyond PO number.
- Redwood: deliver test invoice (sample_invoice_xml_v1.xml) and confirm timestamping/signature method.

Attaching sample files for transparency.

Connor O'Brien
Payments Engineering, Redwood Inference
